symptom: Synthetic re-digested evidence could report reconciliation.status=PASS despite unresolvedCount>0, or reconciliation.status=FAILED with conflictCount=0. The outer verdict remained internally consistent with its own conditional/failure rules, so the validator did not enforce the mapper's count-derived reconciliation status. No private, production or external K-source data was used.
lesson: An outer verdict derived from counts can be correct even when an inner reconciliation.status contradicts the mapper's own status semantics. Re-digesting the object is not an authority proof. The two statuses require independent consistency checks.
guardrail: Require reconciliation.status=FAILED iff conflictCount>0, else CONDITIONAL iff unresolvedCount>0 or rejectedCount>0, else PASS; continue to compute the outer shadow-evidence verdict separately for zero-row and bounded-limit cases. Regress both PASS-with-unresolved and FAILED-without-conflict synthetic re-digested claims.
